texture_prompt.text: Lunar energy facility thermal radiator tower, realistic hard surface industrial equipment. Light grey coated metal central housing, dark graphite anodized metal horizontal radiator fins, brushed metal pipe fittings and frame, small orange service identification marks. Subtle manufactured surface detail, restrained wear, neutral albedo without baked shadows or painted highlights. No heavy dirt, no extra objects, no camouflage. Preserve segmented geometry and UV layout.
